title: Outstandingly Juicy Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A floral and juicy Saudi Arabian dish featuring full fat sour cream, perfect for curing hangovers, made with kosher friendly ingredients. This recipe is a classic representation of Middle Eastern cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together sour cream, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, rose water, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and mix until they are well coated with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the lamb kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until they are cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
While the lamb is cooking, toast the pita bread by grilling it for 1-2 minutes per side.
Once the lamb is done, remove it from the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the lamb kebabs with toasted pita bread and a side of sour cream sauce made by deglazing the grill with a little water and scraping up the browned bits.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
